_comment: Resist! Enemy cards. 32 total across 8 types. Each physical card has a Defense value (shield, top-left) and a timing keyword (DEFEND/DEFEAT/SURVIVE) with an effect. Within a type the effect text is identical; only the Defense value varies. 'defenseValues' lists the Defense of every physical copy (its length = the count of that type). Transcribed from Enemy Cards.jpg (3 rows: 11 + 11 + 10 = 32, matching the rulebook's stated 32 — the handoff's '33' was a miscount).

types.name: Counter-Guerrilla
types.effect: Draw a card from the Civilian deck and place it face-up in the Graveyard.

types.name: Military
types.effect: Shuffle all hidden Maquis in play and remove one from the game.

types.name: Guard
types.effect: You must defeat all Guards before you defeat the Mission.

types.name: Grunt
types.effect: You must defeat all Grunts before you defeat other Enemies.

types.name: Spy Master
types.effect: Add a new Spy card to the Hidden discard pile.

types.name: Jailor
types.effect: Draw a card from the Recruit deck and place it in the Hidden discard pile.

types.name: Engineer
types.effect: Increase the Defense value of all Enemies other than Engineers on this Mission by 1.

types.name: Radio Operator
types.effect: Place a face-down Enemy on all other Missions.
